text_en: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went to the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
text_cn: 耶稣讲完这些话以后，就离开加里肋亚，来到约但对岸的犹太境内。

text_en: Large crowds followed him, and he cured them there.
text_cn: 有许多群众跟随他，他就在那里医好了他们。

text_en: Some Pharisees came to him, and to test him they asked, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any cause? ”
text_cn: 有些法利塞人来到他跟前，试探他说：“许不许人为了任何缘故休自己的妻子？”

text_en: He answered, “Have you not read that the one who made them at the beginning ‘made them male and female, ’
text_cn: 他回答说：“你们没有念过：那创造者自起初就造了他们一男一女；

text_en: and said, ‘For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh’?
text_cn: 且说：‘为此，人要离开父亲和母亲，依附自己的妻子，两人成为一体’的话吗？

text_en: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate. ”
text_cn: 这样，他们不是两个，而是一体了。为此，凡天主所结合的，人不可拆散。”

text_en: They said to him, “Why then did Moses command us to give a certificate of dismissal and to divorce her? ”
text_cn: 他们对他说：“那么，为什么梅瑟还吩咐人下休书休妻呢？”

text_en: He said to them, “It was because you were so hard-hearted that Moses allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it was not so.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“梅瑟为了你们的心硬，才准许你们休妻；但起初并不是这样。

text_en: And I say to you, whoever divorces his wife, except for unchastity, and marries another commits adultery. ”
text_cn: 如今我对你们说：无论谁休妻，除非因为姘居，而另娶一个，他就是犯奸淫；凡娶被休的，也是犯奸淫。”

text_en: His disciples said to him, “If such is the case of a man with his wife, it is better not to marry. ”
text_cn: 门徒对他说：“人同妻子的关系，如果是这样，倒不如不娶的好。”

text_en: But he said to them, “Not everyone can accept this teaching, but only those to whom it is given.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“这话不是人人所能领悟的，只有那些得了恩赐的人，才能领悟。

text_en: For there are eunuchs who have been so from birth, and there are eunuchs who have been made eunuchs by others, and there are eunuchs who have made themselves eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. Let anyone accept this who can. ”
text_cn: 因为有些阉人，从母胎生来就是这样；有些阉人，是被人阉的；有些阉人，却是为了天国，而自阉的。能领悟的，就领悟吧！”

text_en: Then little children were being brought to him in order that he might lay his hands on them and pray. The disciples spoke sternly to those who brought them;
text_cn: 那时，有人给耶稣领来一些小孩子，要他给他们覆手祈祷，门徒却斥责他们。

text_en: but Jesus said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not stop them; for it is to such as these that the kingdom of heaven belongs. ”
text_cn: 耶稣说：“你们让小孩子来吧！不要阻止他们到我跟前来，因为天国正是属于这样的人。”

text_en: And he laid his hands on them and went on his way.
text_cn: 耶稣给他们覆了手，就从那里走了。

text_en: Then someone came to him and said, “Teacher, what good deed must I do to have eternal life? ”
text_cn: 有一个人来到耶稣跟前说：“师傅！我该行什么‘善’，为得永生？”

text_en: And he said to him, “Why do you ask me about what is good? There is only one who is good. If you wish to enter into life, keep the commandments. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“你为什么问我关于‘善’？善的只有一个。 如果你愿意进入生命，就该遵守诫命。”

text_en: He said to him, “Which ones? ” And Jesus said, “You shall not murder; You shall not commit adultery; You shall not steal; You shall not bear false witness;
text_cn: 他对耶稣说：“什么诫命？”耶稣说：“就是：不可杀人，不可奸淫，不可偷盗，不可作假见证；

text_en: Honor your father and mother; also, You shall love your neighbor as yourself. ”
text_cn: 应孝敬父母，应爱你的近人，如爱你自己。”

text_en: The young man said to him, “I have kept all these; what do I still lack? ”
text_cn: 那少年人对耶稣说：“这一切我都遵守了，还缺少什么？”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “If you wish to be perfect, go, sell your possessions, and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“你若愿意是成全的，去！变卖你所有的，施舍给穷人，你必有宝藏在天上；然后来跟随我。”

text_en: When the young man heard this word, he went away grieving, for he had many possessions.
text_cn: 少年人一听这话，就忧闷的走了，因为他拥有许多产业。

text_en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “Truly I tell you, it will be hard for a rich person to enter the kingdom of heaven.
text_cn: 于是，耶稣对门徒说：“我实在告诉你们：富人难进天国。

text_en: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God. ”
text_cn: 我再告诉你们：骆驼穿过针孔，比富人进天国还容易。”

text_en: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astounded and said, “Then who can be saved? ”
text_cn: 门徒们听了，就非常惊异说：“这样，谁还能得救呢？”

text_en: But Jesus looked at them and said, “For mortals it is impossible, but for God all things are possible. ”
text_cn: 耶稣注视他们说：“为人这是不可能的；但为天主，一切都是可能的。”

text_en: Then Peter said in reply, “Look, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have? ”
text_cn: 那时，伯多禄开口对他说：“看，我们舍弃了一切，跟随了你；那么，将来我们可得到什么呢？”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man is seated on the throne of his glory, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“我实在告诉你们：你们这些跟随我的人，在重生的世代，人子坐在自己光荣的宝座上时，你们也要坐在十二宝座上，审判以色列十二支派；

text_en: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or children or fields, for my name’s sake, will receive a hundredfold, and will inherit eternal life.
text_cn: 并且，凡为我的名，舍弃了房屋、或兄弟、或姊妹、或父亲、或母亲、或妻子、或儿女、或田地的，必要领取百倍的赏报，并承受永生。

text_en: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
text_cn: 有许多在先的要成为在后的，在后的要成为在先的。”
